summary_en: Kawaguchi Chemical raised its full-year dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending November 2026 from 60 yen to 70 yen per share, reflecting better-than-expected earnings and allowing the company to return results to shareholders while maintaining investment capacity and financial soundness.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Dividend Forecast (Dividend Increase)
translation_en_brief:
Kawaguchi Chemical announced on October 8, 2026 that its board of directors resolved to raise the full-year dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending November 2026. The year-end dividend per share was increased from the previously projected 60 yen to 70 yen, representing an increase of 10 yen.

The company cited better-than-expected earnings performance in the current fiscal period and a comprehensive review of the business environment, revenue trends, and financial condition as reasons for the revision. The company emphasized that it can provide appropriate returns to shareholders through the increased dividend while maintaining sufficient funds for growth investments and ensuring sound financial health.

The company stated that going forward, it will continue to balance growth investment and financial soundness, appropriately link business progress and improving profitability to shareholder returns, and work toward sustained improvement in corporate value.
